underlines.text: called on us in this familiar way

reference.text: As she had heard no carriage, she thought it not unlikely to be Lady Catherine; and under that apprehension was putting away her half-finished letter, that she might escape all impertinent questions, when the door opened, and to her very great surprise Mr. Darcy, and Mr. Darcy only, entered the room.

underlines.text: when Elizabeth told of his silence

reference.text: They then sat down, and when her inquiries after Rosings were made, seemed in danger of sinking into total silence.

underlines.text: frequently sat there ten minutes together without opening his lips

reference.text: Darcy related the mistake which had occasioned his intruding on Miss Bennet, and, after sitting a few minutes longer, without saying much to anybody, went away.
